name: Challenge rules switch level scaling off for the character holding them
contract: ChallengeRuleTypes.dbc names NO_CREATURE_LEVEL_SCALING and NO_QUEST_LEVEL_SCALING. Ironman - Overwhelming Odds (71) carries only the creature rule; Hardcore - Inn-Sane (76) carries both. Requires DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, offset 5 and CoA.QuestLevelScaling=1. Every character turns open world scaling on through the native request and is level 32. A level-1 creature is viewed at 27 (32 minus the offset) by a character without either rule, and at its authored level 1 while the creature rule is active. Kobold Camp Cleanup (7) is authored at level 2; its QuestTemplateScaling.dbc row (min 2, max 20, offset -4 from level 6) plays it at 20 for a level-32 character, and at its authored level 2 while the quest rule is active. Stopping the challenge gives the scaling back without a relog: the view returns to 27 and the creature's level is re-sent to the owner's session.
